newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on crusher, spread despite CBOT.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on crusher, spread despite CBOT.

text.p: WCE canola ended up on active crusher buying and export demand in active spreading despite a reversal in nearby CBOT soybeans, traders said.

"The huge bean reversal pushed us down but the spreading kept us on the positive side," a trader said. March canola futures crush margin rose to -22.31 Thursday from -22.36 Wednesday. Three hundred July-Nov spread at $44, 250 Aug-Nov $36, 200 Mar-July $2 and March-May $1. Volume was 7,750 lots.
Japan bought 10,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
March canola rose $0.60 to $414, May up $1.40 to $414.50. March flax up $2.90 to $353, May up $2.50 to $354. Mar-May $1.

March western barley rose $1.60 to $141.50, May up $2.70 to $142.20 with Midland Walwyn the best buyer. Cargill, ADM unit Benson Quinn and PCTS bought Mar-May at even money. Volume was 2,250 lots. Oats and feed peas did not trade.
March feed wheat rose $2.20 to $173.90, May up $1.70 to $169.20 on commission short covering while commercials bought new crop. Mar-July spread at $7.50, July-Dec $6. Volume was 1,170 lots.
(Values in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats and peas.)
